instruction: `camel_to_snake` in `textutils/case.py` fails to insert an underscore before a single trailing uppercase letter. `camel_to_snake('camelC')` returns `camelc` instead of `camel_c`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/textutils/case.py b/textutils/case.py
--- a/textutils/case.py
+++ b/textutils/case.py
@@ -21,4 +21,4 @@
     ``"camelC"`` -> ``"camel_c"``.
     """
     s1 = re.sub(r"(.)([A-Z][a-z]+)", r"\1_\2", text)
-    return s1.lower()
+    return re.sub(r"([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", r"\1_\2", s1).lower()
